Scripting & API: Use PowerShell, Bash, and Python to automate repetitive tasks and interact with the Microsoft Graph API for custom reporting. End-User Enablement: Create comprehensive documentation, self-service guides, and conduct training sessions for end-users to drive the effective adoption of collaboration tools. Manage day-to-day delivery and support of application infrastructure services and collaborate with other government agencies and central services teams to facilitate and deliver government-wide services. Leadership & Strategic Alignment End-to-End Delivery: Lead the deployment and service design for large-scale rollouts of new collaboration features and productivity software. Policy Development: Develop organization policies, governance standards, and standard operating procedures for M365 tools, collaborating with security teams to meet regulatory needs. Project Ownership: Take full ownership of broad, ambiguously-scoped rollouts, ensuring successful outcomes, proactive risk mitigation, and seamless change management for end-users.
